changelog: Fix: the symbol dropdown and saved-backtests list could get stuck on "Loading…" forever. Cause: no error handling anywhere in js/backtest.js — a thrown exception (e.g. api()'s res.json() failing on a non-JSON response, such as a PHP fatal error from a missing table) silently aborted the rest of the awaiting function with nothing shown to the user. Every API call in backtest.js now goes through a new btApi() wrapper that normalizes both a thrown exception and an application-level {error} response into a visible "Failed to load …" message. Also note: get_backtest_sessions requires the v3.20.0 migration (backtest_sessions table) to actually be applied — the most likely concrete trigger for the reported symptom if it recurs.

Rework: Backtesting is now three separate screens, never stacked — Screen A (new-backtest form, opens directly from the sidebar, now with a required Session Name field and a "Create Backtest" button), Screen B (the full-bleed replay window — chart, controls, order panel, challenge panel, shown immediately after creating or resuming a session), Screen C (saved backtests — name, symbol, timeframe, status, equity, progress — reached via a "View Backtests" button inside Screen B).

Fix: the replay window's layout — body.backtest-active (dark topbar, full-bleed .main, no page padding) is now toggled exactly when Screen B itself is entered/left, not for the whole Backtesting page, so Screens A/C render as normal light-themed content (matching every other page) instead of the previous stacked, unstyled rendering. The chart+side-panel row uses flex:1 (not a percentage-height chain) to fill the remaining space, a more robust idiom for "grow to fill a flex column." Long/Short order-direction buttons and open-position rows now use real CSS classes instead of inline styles.

The collapsible sidebar (icon rail, hover tooltips, localStorage-persisted, chart resize() on toggle/window-resize) already shipped in v3.19.2 and is unchanged — re-verified working as part of this release's own layout pass.
Migration (manual — see release notes below): migrations/2026_09_25_0002_add_backtest_session_name.sql adds backtest_sessions.session_name.
release_notes: MANUAL DB STEP REQUIRED, not run by this release: after Update Now, run migrate.php?mode=status then mode=run to apply migrations/2026_09_25_0002_add_backtest_session_name.sql (adds backtest_sessions.session_name). This is in addition to migrations/2026_09_25_0001_create_backtest_tables.sql from v3.20.0 -- if that one hasn't been applied yet either, apply it first (mode=run applies every pending file in filename order automatically).
